description: Activate the full WEDM training pipeline using DocuStrata prints + CAD files + paired existing programs. Emit per-part JM templates, per-machine/controller hard-coded feature programs (baseline), wiki + tribal injection nodes per WEDM CAM process, persistent self-learning loop (AI/DL/DR/LoRA/RAG/NN/GNN/ML), and a front-end wire wizard that turns a print into a program after training.
philosophy: PRISM has 103 WEDM engines + 42 state files + 8 playbooks + 5 controller dialects + WEDMPartRecognitionEngine + WEDMContinuousLearningEngine + WEDMLearningLoopEngine + JMDieTrainingCorpusEngine + BlueprintProgramJoinEngine + ProgramPrintLinkIndexEngine + TrainingExampleAssemblerEngine already on disk. The substrate is built. This milestone WIRES it into a persistent end-to-end loop and exposes the wire wizard front-end (U-REV-WEDM-01..07 from REVENUE-ROADMAP-v7.6). NO new physics engines — only orchestrators, catalog generators, dispatcher actions, training pipeline activators, and frontend pages.

phases.title: Hard-Coded Per-Machine/Controller Feature Programs (JM Fleet Baseline)
Front-End Wire Wizard (7 pages from U-REV-WEDM-01..07)

unit_list.title: WEDMTrainingCorpusEngine — WEDM-filtered training corpus orchestrator
unit_list.description: Wrap JMDieTrainingCorpusEngine + BlueprintProgramJoinEngine + ProgramPrintLinkIndexEngine with a WEDM filter. Output: per-program record { print_path, program_path, cad_path?, controller, material, machine, features[], parameters, outcomes? }. No new physics — pure orchestration.

unit_list.title: WEDMProgramPrintPairExtractor — feature/parameter extraction per pair
unit_list.description: For each (print, program) pair from U-WTW01, parse the WEDM program (WireEDMProgramParserEngine) and the print (existing OCR / feature recognizer if available) → emit aligned (features, parameters, controller, machine) tuples ready for training. Persist to data/state/WEDM_TRAINING_PAIRS.jsonl.

unit_list.title: WEDMCADPathMatchEngine — link STEP/IGES/DXF to prints for difficult wire paths
unit_list.description: When a print has matching STEP/IGES/DXF in the archive, attach the 3D geometry to the training tuple. Enables training on 3D-aware wire paths (tapers, complex contours) that 2D-only training misses.

unit_list.title: Dispatcher actions + corpus build CLI
unit_list.description: Wire wedm_training_corpus_build, wedm_training_pairs_extract, wedm_cad_match into prism_edm dispatcher. Also: scripts/build-wedm-training-corpus.mjs CLI for batch runs over JM Die archive.

unit_list.title: WEDMPartFamilyTemplateEngine — per-family parameter templates from corpus
unit_list.description: Run WEDMPartRecognitionEngine over the corpus. Group by part family (punch/die, gear, key, contour, pocket, multi-cavity, complex). For each family, aggregate (material × machine × controller) parameters → emit Template { family, params_by_machine_material, ra_curves, pass_counts, exemplar_programs[] }.

unit_list.title: JM-Die part-template catalog generator (runs across full JM archive)
unit_list.description: Batch CLI that emits state/shared/JM-DIE-WEDM-TEMPLATES.json — one entry per distinct part family found in JM archive, with exemplar programs and learned parameter envelopes.

unit_list.title: Dispatcher actions + tests for template catalog
unit_list.description: wedm_template_query(part_family|material|machine), wedm_template_recommend(print_features). Tests verify catalog round-trip and recommendation precision.

unit_list.title: WEDMFeatureProgramCatalogEngine — controller × feature G-code primitives (JM-fleet baseline)
unit_list.description: Per controller (Mitsubishi, Sodick, Makino, AgieCharmilles, Fanuc) × feature type (square pocket, round pocket, slot, taper, keyway, gear-tooth, complex contour, finish-only, multi-pass, start-hole pattern, parting line, micro-radius) emit a known-correct G-code primitive template. This is the BASELINE — all other machines/controllers inherit from this catalog and override only where dialects differ.

unit_list.title: Wire EDM tribal injection node generator — wiki + tribal per CAM process
unit_list.description: For each WEDM CAM process (rough pass, skim, finish, taper, multi-pass, corner, threading, start-hole, tab-cut), auto-emit (a) wiki entry to knowledge/wiki/code-tribal/wedm-<process>.md and (b) tribal injection node in tribal-embed-index. Sources: corpus parameter envelopes + WEDMStrategyLibraryEngine + existing tribal tips. Use tribal-by-domain-inject doctrine.

unit_list.title: Dispatcher actions + tests for feature-program catalog and tribal nodes
unit_list.description: wedm_feature_program(controller, feature, params), wedm_tribal_query(process), tests verify catalog completeness across 5 controllers × N features.

unit_list.title: WEDMPersistentLearningLoopEngine — AI/DL/DR/LoRA/RAG/NN/GNN/ML orchestrator
unit_list.description: Single orchestrator that wires: (a) ContinuousLearning + OnlineLearning ingest from outcome ledger, (b) FewShot bootstrap for new materials, (c) RLController policy update from production telemetry, (d) PrototypicalNetwork + KnowledgeDistillation for cross-machine transfer, (e) wedm_lora training trigger when corpus delta > N, (f) NeuralTraining ensemble update, (g) RAG retrieval from training corpus, (h) GNN node-embedding update for new feature types. Persists state to WEDM_LEARNING_LOOP_STATE.json.

unit_list.title: First wedm_lora r=4 training run (closes U-TRAIN-13 from REVENUE-ROADMAP-v7.6)
unit_list.description: Execute first end-to-end wedm_lora training run using the U-WTW01 corpus + U-WTW05 templates. r=4 micro-LoRA. Validate accuracy delta on held-out JM Die programs. Persist checkpoint to WEDM_LORA_CHECKPOINT.json.

unit_list.title: Front-end wire wizard scaffolding — 7 pages (U-REV-WEDM-01..07)
unit_list.description: Build React/Vite pages: WireEdmStudioPage (entry + feasibility gate), WireEdmProgramPage, WireEdmCostPage, WireEdmMultipassPage, WireEdmTroubleshootPage, WireEdmControllerSelectPage, WireEdmReportPage. Wire each to existing prism_edm dispatcher actions.

unit_list.title: End-to-end print→program pipeline through wizard (post-training validation)
unit_list.description: Upload print → wizard runs full pipeline (corpus match → template recommend → feature catalog → physics gates → G-code generate → cost estimate). Validates on JM Die held-out prints. Records outcome to WEDM_FEEDBACK_LEDGER for U-WTW11 loop. This closes the user's stated goal: print-to-program for WEDM after training.
